principles: Browse navigation can look like Sahibinden (15 main entries).
Canonical vehicle identity (brand/model/generation/version) is never duplicated per browse segment.
MARKET_SEGMENT / TRANSACTION_MODE / CONDITION_SEGMENT / SPECIAL_SEGMENT nodes apply filters/policies; they do not own separate Brand/Model rows.
bodyType (Sedan, Hatchback, …) is attribute — not Category leaf under Otomobil.
bodySubtype (SUV, Crossover, Arazi Aracı, Pickup) is attribute — not Category leaf under Arazi, SUV ve Pickup.

root.name: Vasıta
root.notes: DB Category root. Children are browse roots shown in main nav.

mainNav.name: Otomobil
mainNav.notes: No Sedan/Hatchback Category children — bodyType attribute.

mainNav.name: Arazi, SUV ve Pickup
mainNav.notes: SUV / Crossover / Arazi Aracı / Pickup are bodySubtype attributes on the form — not browse children. Nav goes straight to brands.

mainNav.name: Elektrikli Araçlar
mainNav.persistsAsCategoryReason: Browse hub Category row; does NOT own Brand/Model rows. Listings resolve to underlying VEHICLE_TYPE Category via allowedVehicleTypes + fuelType.

children.name: Ticari Hat ve Ticari Plaka
children.notes: Policy-heavy listing type; may not bind Brand catalog.

mainNav.name: Kiralık Araçlar
mainNav.persistsAsCategoryReason: Browse hub only. Listings use underlying vehicle Category + Listing.dealType=KIRALIK.

mainNav.name: Klasik Araçlar
mainNav.notes: Prefer canonical Brand/Model when known; allow manual brand/model report when missing.

mainNav.name: UTV
mainNav.notes: New vs current TS (ATV only). No legacy subtype.

dedupeRules: Brand/ProductModel rows keyed by (domain, slug) — never per browseRole segment.
CategoryBrand links only to VEHICLE_TYPE catalogScope Categories (PASSENGER_CAR, SUV_PICKUP, …).
MARKET_SEGMENT / TRANSACTION_MODE / CONDITION_SEGMENT / SPECIAL_SEGMENT hubs never receive CategoryBrand rows.
Listing stores: categoryId of canonical vehicle type (or leaf class), plus attributes for segment flags (fuelType, condition, classicStatus, disabledPlateEligible) and dealType column for rent.
Browse hubs resolve to the same listing via filter predicates — one listing, many browse entry points.
